name: post-deploy-regression-watch-reporter
description: After a deploy, watches the target service golden signals for a window and attributes any regression to that release, correlating error rate, latency, and saturation shifts to the deploy time. Read-only. Recommends optional AWS MCP augmentation (a custom telemetry MCP for a non-connected tool) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SAT at 07:00 UTC
